start_frame: From the centre of the hall toward the west doors, camera low: the frame cannot contain her standing, so it holds her bent neck and shoulder against a verdigris iron whiplash rib of the vault, the last tulip shades still in frame.
end_frame: The same frame as GAUGE THREE lands: her head knocks the rib at 2.80 m, flakes of old gilding sift down through the lamplight and she stoops under the roof — more than nine feet high in a room that cannot hold her.
constraint_honoured: 'GAUGE THREE, last of the three in sequence… THE LAST LAMP FIXTURE the film will ever show.'
movement_note: Fragmentary framing on a held camera is the only way to shoot a 2.74 m girl in a 2.80 m room; from the next shot on, the lens is below 1.00 m and no lamp fitting enters any frame again.
